```{r}
# load the data

# Authenticate with Google Drive
drive_auth(
  scopes = "https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive.readonly",
  cache = FALSE
)

# Find your CSV file in Google Drive
# drive_find("potholes.csv")

# Download the file from Google Drive
drive_download(
  as_id("1bxDXSdQxkfXSBDMyDYjyO7ZqKZOavkU-"),
  path = "potholes.csv",
  overwrite = TRUE
)

# Read the downloaded CSV into R
potholes <- read_csv("potholes.csv")

```

```{r}
# verify data types, number of unique values, and missing values

data_summary <- data.frame(
  column = names(potholes),
  data_type = sapply(potholes, function(x) class(x)[1]),
  unique_values = sapply(potholes, 
                         function(x) n_distinct(x, na.rm = TRUE)),
  missing_values = sapply(potholes, 
                          function(x) sum(is.na(x))),
  missing_percentage = sapply(potholes, 
                              function(x) mean(is.na(x)) * 100)
)

data_summary %>%
  gt(rowname_col = "column") %>%
  tab_header(
    title = "Data Quality Summary",
    subtitle = "Data types, unique values and missing observations"
  ) %>%
  cols_label(
    data_type = "Data Type",
    unique_values = "Unique Values",
    missing_values = "Missing Values",
    missing_percentage = "Missing (%)"
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(
    columns = c(unique_values, missing_values),
    decimals = 0
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(
    columns = missing_percentage,
    decimals = 2
  ) %>%
  data_color(
    columns = missing_percentage,
    palette = c("white", "#F4A6A6")
  ) %>%
  tab_options(
    table.font.size = 12,
    row.striping.include_table_body = TRUE
  )
```

```{r}

# Columns to remove
removed <- c(
  "service_request_id",
  "service_request_parent_id",
  "sap_notification_number",
  "service_name",
  "service_name_detail",
  "lat",
  "lng",
  "street_address",
  "zipcode",
  "park_name",
  "referred",
  "iamfloc",
  "floc",
  "public_description"
)

# # Columns used to identify incomplete observations
# missing <- c(
#   "comm_plan_code",
#   "comm_plan_name",
#   "council_district"
# )

# Check zipcode-to-council-district relationship
zipcode_check <- potholes %>%
  distinct(zipcode, council_district) %>%
  count(zipcode) %>%
  filter(n > 1)

# Create lookup table, retaining only unambiguous matches
district_lookup <- potholes %>%
  filter(!is.na(zipcode), !is.na(council_district)) %>%
  distinct(zipcode, council_district) %>%
  group_by(zipcode) %>%
  filter(n() == 1) %>%
  ungroup()

# Clean and impute data
potholes2 <- potholes |>
  mutate(
    date_closed = coalesce(
      date_closed,
      date_requested + days(case_age_days)
    )
  ) |>
  left_join(
    district_lookup,
    by = "zipcode",
    suffix = c("", "_lookup")
  ) |>
  mutate(
    council_district = coalesce(
      council_district,
      council_district_lookup
    )
  ) |>
  select(-council_district_lookup) |>
  select(-all_of(removed))

# Create data quality summary
data_summary2 <- data.frame(
  column = names(potholes2),
  data_type = sapply(potholes2, function(x) class(x)[1]),
  unique_values = sapply(potholes2,
                         function(x) n_distinct(x, na.rm = TRUE)),
  missing_values = sapply(potholes2,
                          function(x) sum(is.na(x))),
  missing_percentage = sapply(potholes2,
                               function(x) mean(is.na(x)) * 100)
)

# Display summary table
data_summary2 %>%
  gt(rowname_col = "column") %>%
  tab_header(
    title = "Data Quality Summary After Cleaning",
    subtitle = "Data types, unique values and missing observations"
  ) %>%
  cols_label(
    data_type = "Data Type",
    unique_values = "Unique Values",
    missing_values = "Missing Values",
    missing_percentage = "Missing (%)"
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(
    columns = c(unique_values, missing_values),
    decimals = 0
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(
    columns = missing_percentage,
    decimals = 2
  ) %>%
  data_color(
    columns = missing_percentage,
    palette = c("white", "#F4A6A6")
  ) %>%
  tab_options(
    table.font.size = 12,
    row.striping.include_table_body = TRUE
  )

```

```{r}
# convert datetime data in date_requested and date_closed columns to date only

potholes3 <- potholes2 |>
  mutate(
    date_requested = as.Date(date_requested),
    date_closed = as.Date(date_closed)
  )

# create tsibbles of potholes3 indexed on date_requested and date_closed and aggregate the counts of tickets requested or closed each day

req_ts <- potholes3 |>
  count(date_requested, name = "requests") %>%
  as_tsibble(index = date_requested)

print(has_gaps(req_ts))

# Identify missing dates
print(scan_gaps(req_ts))

cls_ts <- potholes3 |>
  count(date_closed, name = "closed") %>%
  as_tsibble(index = date_closed)

print(has_gaps(cls_ts))

print(scan_gaps(cls_ts))
```

```{r}
# Missing dates in requested-date tsibble
missing_req <- req_ts %>%
  scan_gaps()

# Missing dates in closed-date tsibble
missing_cls <- cls_ts %>%
  scan_gaps()

missing_req_check <- missing_req %>%
  rename(date = date_requested) %>%
  left_join(
    potholes %>%
      mutate(date = as.Date(date_requested)) %>%
      count(date, name = "original_records"),
    by = "date"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    present_in_original = !is.na(original_records)
  )

missing_cls_check <- missing_cls %>%
  rename(date = date_closed) %>%
  left_join(
    potholes %>%
      mutate(date = as.Date(date_closed)) %>%
      count(date, name = "original_records"),
    by = "date"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    present_in_original = !is.na(original_records)
  )

# Requested dates
missing_req_check %>%
  count(present_in_original) %>%
  rename(
    Present_in_Original = present_in_original,
    Number_of_Dates = n
  )

# Closed dates
missing_cls_check %>%
  count(present_in_original) %>%
  rename(
    Present_in_Original = present_in_original,
    Number_of_Dates = n
  )

```

```{r}
# the missing dates did not have any requests or cases closed
# the missing dates were filled in with zero events on those dates

req_ts_complete <- req_ts %>%
  fill_gaps() %>%
  mutate(date_requested = replace_na(date_requested, 0))

has_gaps(req_ts_complete)

cls_ts_complete <- cls_ts %>%
  fill_gaps() %>%
  mutate(date_closed = replace_na(date_closed, 0))

has_gaps(cls_ts_complete)
```

```{r}
# view plot of requests over time

req_ts_complete %>%
  autoplot(requests) +
  labs(
    title = "Daily Pothole Requests",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Number of Requests"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
# view plot of closed cases over time

cls_ts_complete %>%
  autoplot(closed) +
  labs(
    title = "Daily Pothole Requests Closed",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Number of Requests Closed"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
# aggregate cases opened based on month

monreq_ts <- req_ts_complete %>%
  mutate(month = yearmonth(date_requested)) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  group_by(month) %>%
  summarise(
    requests = sum(requests, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  as_tsibble(index = month)

monreq_ts %>%
  autoplot(requests) +
  labs(
    title = "Monthly Pothole Requests",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Number of Requests"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
# aggregate cases closed based on month

moncls_ts <- cls_ts_complete %>%
  mutate(month = yearmonth(date_closed)) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  group_by(month) %>%
  summarise(
    closed = sum(closed, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  as_tsibble(index = month)

moncls_ts %>%
  autoplot(closed) +
  labs(
    title = "Monthly Pothole Requests Closed",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Number of Requests Closed"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
# Split request data into train/validation sets
req_trn <- req_ts_complete |>
  filter_index(. ~ '2024-12-31')
req_val <- req_ts_complete |>
  filter_index('2025-01-01' ~ .)
```

```{r}
# Split closed data into train/validation sets
cls_trn <- cls_ts_complete |>
  filter_index(. ~ '2024-12-31')
cls_val <- cls_ts_complete |>
  filter_index('2025-01-01' ~ .)
```

```{r}
# Time Series Linear Model - Requests
req_tslm <- req_trn %>%
  model(
    auto_tslm = TSLM(requests),
    tr_tslm = TSLM(requests ~ trend()),
    sea_tslm = TSLM(requests ~ season()),
    tslm = TSLM(requests ~ trend() + season())
  )

# Model summary
report(req_tslm)

glance(req_tslm) %>%
  select(.model, r_squared, adj_r_squared, AIC, AICc, BIC) %>%
  arrange(AIC) %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = "TSLM Model Comparison",
    subtitle = "Models ranked by AIC"
  ) %>%
  cols_label(
    .model = "Model",
    r_squared = "R-squared",
    adj_r_squared = "Adjusted R-squared",
    AIC = "AIC",
    AICc = "AICc",
    BIC = "BIC"
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(
    columns = c(r_squared, adj_r_squared),
    decimals = 3
  ) %>%
    fmt_number(
    columns = c(AIC, AICc, BIC),
    decimals = 0
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_body(rows = 1)
  )

req_trn %>%
  autoplot(requests) +
  autolayer(
    fitted(req_tslm |> select("tslm")),
    .fitted,
    colour = "red"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "TSLM: Monthly Pothole Requests",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Number of Requests"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```
